VI.description: READ-ONLY. Reads a Ring control's entry list off a running panel\2C by the control's index in Controls[].\0A\0ATHE CAST IS THE WHOLE POINT. Controls[] hands back GENERIC control references\2C and a Property Node typed {LV.Ring} refuses one - 'Invalid property' - because Strings [] does not exist on the generic class. To More Specific Class does the downcast\2C taking the wanted class as a REFNUM CONSTANT on its target class input. An earlier revision concluded the entries simply could not be read and fell back on guessing an index\2C which is how a run came within one button press of scripting an event into the wrong module.\0A\0AWHY IT MATTERS HERE. A ring index is not portable\3A launched from the Tools menu\2C Delacor's Module ring has '<Select a Module>' at 0\2C and the order after it follows neither the project order nor the alphabet - measured\2C index 1 was FirstClone.lvlib while Parse Project for DQMH Modules.vi lists DQMHdemo first. So the list has to be read\2C never derived.
